notes.title: DevLog #2: Grimstone Survivors New Biomes, CO-OP, and More! 🔥🔥
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Grimstone Survivors Dev Diary #2: New Biomes, CO-OP, and More! 🔥🔥[/b][/h1]

[h1][b]Hello Grimstone Players![/b][/h1]

In this devlog, we’re introducing one of the biggest updates to Grimstone Survivors.

The Meta Progression System, CO-OP System, and New Biomes are on their way!

With brand-new biomes, we’re bringing a whole new atmosphere and strategic depth to the game. Each biome comes with its own environmental challenges and unique enemy traits to test your skills. Through the CO-OP system, you’ll tackle these new worlds with friends, and the meta progression will make you smarter and stronger with every run.

Get ready, because this update is unlocking the doors to exciting discoveries and tactical battles!

[h1][b]CO-OP System Is Coming![/b][/h1]

You will now be able to play Grimstone Survivors with your friends. The CO-OP mode allows you to face waves of enemies shoulder-to-shoulder, relying on teamwork! We’ve focused on enhancing team mechanics to deepen strategic gameplay. Are you ready?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/be88037607b8063baed4501ba6b4477d20405cef.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]New Enemy Algorithm[/b][/h1]

Enemies are now smarter and more dynamic!

Ragdoll physics make enemy reactions more natural.
With new behavior algorithms, enemies execute more strategic attacks.
Types like tanks and fast enemies adapt better to environmental factors.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/11cca7812a6b5f2d7c92fe9faebc3b243fa00f1b.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/0d9a021edffdc34f7928e577b652b43609adbc71.gif[/img]

[h1]Performance Optimizations[/h1]

Every second of the game is now smoother!

FPS optimizations ensure a seamless experience even on lower-end hardware.
We’ve implemented numerous background improvements to enhance performance during intense enemy waves.
We’ve completely reworked visuals and the user interface. With more readable texts, intuitive menus, and an aesthetic look, the UI now truly reflects the spirit of the game. The wave selection and market screens are more user-friendly and understandable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/578cecad66a1fb5319a79a69e2373d0b9058d7e8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/b2162c2fed05e2a09a4a6924153c174e68136dc4.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]New Biomes and Difficulty Levels[/b][/h1]

The Grimstone Survivors universe is expanding!

With brand-new biomes, we’re adding varied atmospheres and strategic depth to the game. Each biome introduces unique environmental challenges and enemy traits.

The difficulty level system is here! Now, we offer different modes to make the game enjoyable for both beginners and masters. Are you ready to test yourself?

[h1][b]Meta Progression Layer Added[/b][/h1]

We’ve introduced unique active abilities that guide players toward diverse playstyles, offering depth for both close-quarters and ranged strategies. These abilities adapt to various combat scenarios, adding strategic richness to the game.

[h1][b]New Mechanic: Soul Gauge and Ultimate Fire[/b][/h1]

A brand-new mechanic is here to give players more control!

Soul Gauge System: Each creature you defeat fills the soul gauge.
Shift Key and Aiming: You can fire the charged soul gauge in any direction by pressing the Shift key. This allows for effective crowd control.
Charge Effects: The strength and area of effect of your shots vary depending on how full the soul gauge is. Use it strategically for an edge in battle!
[h1][b]Twin Stick Control Option[/b][/h1]

To provide players with more freedom and control, we’ve added a new feature:

Twin Stick Control Mode: Choose this option when starting the game or via the settings menu. This mode is designed for players who prefer a more tactical approach without relying on auto-fire.
Auto-Fire Option: This feature remains available for those who enjoy simplicity and fast-paced gameplay.
This update lets you fully control your gameplay style.

[h1]Community Feedback[/h1]

Since the game isn’t released yet, we haven’t started collecting community feedback. However, once the demo is out, we’ll carefully evaluate feedback from our community to make further improvements. Your input is crucial! Testing the game and sharing your thoughts with us is extremely important.

[b]Join our Discord server to contribute!

[url=https://discord.gg/SXhrAkEevb][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/b8e9862146ba111bdb1d190eaa8f37c3866b9dd0.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1][b]Quick FAQ[/b][/h1]

[h2]When will the full version be released?[/h2]

We don’t have a set date yet, but we plan to launch the game in Early Access during the first quarter of 2025. Add the game to your wishlist to stay updated on the release date!

[h2]How much will the game cost?[/h2]

It will likely be priced between $2.99 and $4.99.

[h2]Will there be an endless mode?[/h2]

Most likely, yes. However, the demo version will feature a standard game with 10-15 levels.

[h2]Will there be meta-progression?[/h2]

Yes! You’ll be able to unlock new items, weapons, and features by completing challenges and achievements in the game.

[h1][b]ADD TO YOUR WISHLIST ✔️[/b][/h1]

Excited to play? Then add the game to your wishlist and don’t miss any updates! With your support and feedback, we’ll continue to grow and improve!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/da8b1ca645f41cd6e8db23975ee738b39ef09715.gif[/img]

notes.title: New Update – Grimstone Survivor (v.0.2.6)
notes.notes:
[url=https://discord.gg/SXhrAkEevb][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/b8e9862146ba111bdb1d190eaa8f37c3866b9dd0.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1][b]Hello Heroes of the Stone Realm! 👋[/b][/h1]

Explosive new updates have arrived in Grimstone Survivors!

Here are the new features and adjustments brought by version v.0.2.6:

[h2][b]Update Notes (v.0.2.6)[/b][/h2]

[h2][b]New Major Stone Boss – End Game Boss 👹[/b][/h2]

We've finally added a rock-solid Boss to the end of the game! This boss shakes the ground, shatters stones, and makes you question your life as it approaches. Can you conquer this stone giant?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/fe5956238e8226d10dc9efac58736de837a8e29b.gif[/img]

[h2][b]New Explosive Creature and Stones 💥[/b][/h2]

Surprise! We've added a new creature that begins to shiver ominously when you get close, then suddenly explodes. As they say: “If you approach the stone, be prepared for the blast!”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/5b9bb18113aed663311bc7a200ab9d0382f5b689.gif[/img]

Exploding Stones are scattered across the map! These strategically placed stones will shake and detonate when you get close. Their explosions can also trigger nearby stones for an even deadlier chain reaction. Think before you act – the power of destruction is in your hands!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/644f41f530459c6105e9cef12b7cc013aef91fb5.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Corrupted Zone and Enemy Rage System 💜[/b][/h2]

A special "Corrupted Zone" now exists on the map! Enemies become Corrupted and immediately empowered when they step into this area. Are you ready to face crazed enemies covered in purple material and with fiery eyes? Or will you use this zone to draw enemies in and strategize?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/03fa51554fa3f7ba7ecebc3780da4b09eaf666ea.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Objective System 🎯[/b][/h2]

We now have new objectives! Completing these missions allows you to enhance active abilities or unlock brand-new active skills. Get ready to strategize because things just got deeper!

[h2][b]Active Skill Development System ⚡[/b][/h2]

Active abilities can now evolve! If you've ever thought, "I wish this ability was a bit stronger" while fighting, now it’s possible. More power, more excitement!

[h2][b]New Skill: Turret 🔫[/b][/h2]

Introducing the latest engineering marvel: the Turret Active Item! Now, you can place mini towers on the map and corner your enemies with engineering prowess. Could this be a hint at a new class? We’ll see in upcoming updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/047cb3ad4a37a94c27b2fadfbb4ba414efd9c8e2.gif[/img]

[h2][b]New Skill: Pulse Grenade ⚡[/b][/h2]

Meet the Pulse Grenade! This skill creates a lightning strike that deals AOE (area-of-effect) damage where it lands. Add an electric touch to the battle and daze your enemies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/e377bb5a966398ee633724fdaf22ef064953fb0a.gif[/img]

[h2][b]New Passive Items 🛠️[/b][/h2]

New passive items that will fundamentally change your playstyle have arrived. These items will make you think twice about your choices. "With this item, will I become a rock or dust?" Time to decide!

[h3][b]Blood Pact Effect:[/b][/h3]

The player's maximum health is fixed at 50%. However, each attack deals 30% extra damage.

[h3][b]Stone Heart Effect:[/b][/h3]

When the player's health drops below 25%, they gain 50% resistance to all damage.

[h3][b]Adrenaline Rush Effect:[/b][/h3]

The player gains a 20% movement speed boost for 10 seconds after each enemy kill. However, health regeneration stops during this speed boost.

[h3][b]Soul Stealer Effect:[/b][/h3]

The player increases their maximum health by 2% with each enemy killed. However, they lose 5% of their current health every 30 seconds.

[h3][b]Touch of Korruption Effect:[/b][/h3]

The player gains a 50% damage bonus while in the Korruption zone, but loses 10% of their current health when they leave the zone.

[h3][b]Lost Soul Effect:[/b][/h3]

With each health loss, the player gains a 10% boost in attack power. However, each boost only lasts for 20 seconds.

[h3][b]Rebirth Effect:[/b][/h3]

When the player dies, they respawn with unlimited power for 10 seconds. However, each kill during this time extends the respawn duration by 10%.

[h2][b]Fair Enemy Spawn System 🧱[/b][/h2]

Enemies now spawn at a greater distance! Previously, enemies would appear right next to you, making it feel like the area was overrun with stones. We’ve adjusted their spawn points, providing a fairer and more strategic gameplay experience.

[h2][b]Performance and Optimization Improvements 🚀[/b][/h2]

Some players reported performance drops when there were too many enemies, bullets, or items on the screen. We've begun general optimization work on this and are actively working on permanent solutions. We're doing everything we can to offer a smoother and more rock-solid gaming experience soon!

[h2][b]Community Feedback 🙌[/b][/h2]

This update was prepared based on valuable feedback from our community. Thank you for your support throughout our development process! Every comment and suggestion you share is extremely valuable to us. We’re grateful to have you on this journey with us. See you in the next update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/6b71ff4507294de5c8df519473fac3e015008bf7.png[/img]

💬 Main Menu Improvements: The main menu scene has been reworked with improvements.

💬 Map Borders: Map boundaries have been adjusted.

💬 Collider Fixes: Colliders in areas where players got stuck have been reviewed and all issues have been fixed.

Puncher: Damage increased from 2 to 3.

Sword: Damage increased from 3 to 4.

Potion Limit: All bullet effect potions in the market now have a limit of 1 to prevent stacking.

notes.title: Now Broadcasting : Watch the community play
DevLog 1# : Grimstone Survivors Weapons Development Upgrade
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Grimstone Survivors Devlog #1: Weapon Development Update![/b][/h1]

[url=https://discord.gg/SXhrAkEevb][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/b8e9862146ba111bdb1d190eaa8f37c3866b9dd0.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1][b]Hello Survivors![/b][/h1]

In this development update, we want to talk about guns. Not the ones attached to a stout dwarf’s shoulder, but the ones used to enhance a cave through the merciless culling of glyphids.

[h1][b]About the Game[/b][/h1]

Grimstone Survivors is a fast-paced 3D top-down roguelite action game set in a stone universe. Players must survive waves of enemies while collecting materials from defeated foes to craft and upgrade their weapons. The game features automatic firing mechanics, dynamic weapon combinations, and strategic decision-making, encouraging quick and strategic thinking. Our physics-based interactions and dynamic map structures ensure that each playthrough is unique and exhilarating.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/36c7a1ca95d7c3ede0e01603884886b89dfc9778.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Current Development Status and Progress Updates[/b][/h1]

[h2]Physics-Based Gameplay and Dynamic Map Structure[/h2]

Since starting our project in ''June 2024'', we've developed the core gameplay mechanics and completed our first prototype, including the basic weapon crafting system. Our physics engine in ''Unity'' ensures realistic enemy movements, with enemies flinging dynamically during battles.

We're also enhancing the ''dynamic map structure'', allowing players to break or dismantle objects to open or close paths, enabling varied strategies each wave. To improve readability and accessibility, we're simplifying the user interface and adding in-game guides. These aspects will be further improved over time.

So far, we haven't received any feedback from the community as the game hasn't been released yet. We are currently preparing the demo and look forward to engaging with our community soon. Once the demo is released, your feedback will be invaluable in helping us refine and improve the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/594b62ae8b7d1e4a08057c53c053b6ca8d0f6376.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/deb3cd228a09ffa9524d6719481dcd0eca6e3a07.gif[/img]

[h1]Market Algorithms[/h1]

Market algorithms allow players to manage the in-game economy efficiently. By making strategic decisions, you can use your resources effectively and try different strategies in each game session. Our market system carefully considers class and character synergies, ensuring that each game experience is unique and engaging, encouraging players to experiment with different combinations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/6af72bc25c3cf3a38a30e4292e95413c8cf6606b.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/738efa03d633b1197e8fa2bff03a7a8df38339b5.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Weapons Development[/b][/h1]

[h2]Puncher ( Pusback Type Fist )[/h2]

Our Puncher is a melee, unarmed weapon that stands out with its ability to hurl enemies into the air. When enemies land, they take additional damage, making the Puncher a formidable tool for crowd control and maximizing damage output during close-quarters combat.

[b]It’s the big piercing punch in the sea of smaller punch![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/6668345faea851866bbf16af4cbbd0705a25ece0.gif[/img]

[h2]Laser Gun[/h2]

The Laser Gun is an SMG with elemental properties, offering low but precise and fast firing capabilities. It fires a beam that starts as a large energy blast and narrows over three seconds, dealing high initial damage that decreases to 50% as the beam tightens. This weapon excels in providing consistent damage over time while requiring strategic positioning to maximize its effectiveness before the damage output diminishes.

[b]Check out the Laser Gun in action:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/fa3d7bad61d173b64bb3b964bde18189642a818d.gif[/img]

[h2]Fire Fist (Elemental Melee)[/h2]

The ''Fire Fist'' is a melee, unarmed weapon with elemental properties that brings a burning effect to combat. With each consecutive hit on the same enemy, the Fire Fist builds up heat, igniting the target after the third consecutive strike. This makes it an excellent choice for dealing sustained damage, especially against tougher enemies. Its fast attack speed combined with the burn effect makes it a powerful tool for keeping enemies under pressure while dealing continuous damage over time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/497711f8b40caf5ec63a85bd7304dc601a4593c3.gif[/img]

[h2]MiniGun[/h2]

The MiniGun is an SMG known for its rapid-fire capabilities. It fires a high volume of bullets quickly, making it ideal for overwhelming enemies with sheer firepower. However, after firing 100 bullets, it requires a 4.4-second cooldown, and each subsequent hit reduces its damage by 50%. This makes the MiniGun a high-risk, high-reward weapon, perfect for aggressive playstyles that can manage its cooldown periods and maximize its damage output before the damage starts to wane.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/f47305cb6061c147ac84207a396601d1d7ae1e55.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Active Skills[/b][/h1]

To complement our diverse arsenal, we've introduced various active skills that push players towards unique playstyles, encouraging both close and long-range strategies with varying depths. These skills are designed to enhance gameplay by providing strategic options that cater to different combat scenarios.

[h3]Bullet Potions[/h3]

[b]Description:[/b] When activated, Bullet Potions imbue your ammunition with elemental effects. Each shot carries a different elemental power, such as fire, ice, or electricity, dealing additional damage or debuffs to enemies. This adds a tactical advantage by allowing you to choose the right elemental effect for the right situation, enhancing your overall battlefield control and damage potential.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/a4cfd84547acc6544584dd48f189b98a32ccddda.gif[/img]

[h3]Special Combo[/h3]

[b]Blastoise + Magnetude Combo:[/b] These two skills together create a powerful combo. Magnetude pulls enemies in and Blastoise delivers a destructive area-of-effect blast, sending enemies flying while dealing massive damage. Discovering and using these skill combinations will be key to mastering the game.
